subject.title: memory flush never triggers when reserveTokensFloor equals contextWindow

question: What should OpenClaw do when `reserveTokensFloor + memoryFlush.softThresholdTokens` leaves no positive token gate for the active context window?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but changing this behavior affects existing operator config semantics and overlaps with adjacent reserve/soft-threshold PRs, so the permanent clamp, warning, validation, or doctor-migration policy needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Centralize effective threshold clamp
options.body: Clamp only the effective memory-flush/preflight threshold or reserve used at runtime, keep existing config valid, and add tests plus docs for the derived behavior.

options.title: Validate and migrate config
options.body: Reject or doctor-fix oversized reserve-floor settings so runtime only sees canonical values, at the cost of a more explicit upgrade path for existing users.

options.title: Defer to adjacent budget PR
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the maintainer decision on adjacent reserve/soft-threshold PRs before accepting a narrow local fix.

recommendation.title: Centralize effective threshold clamp
recommendation.body: Clamp only the effective memory-flush/preflight threshold or reserve used at runtime, keep existing config valid, and add tests plus docs for the derived behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected feature history and current-line blame both point to this owner as the best available decision route for memory-flush budget policy.
